Requirement: The system shall display the following default columns on the landing page for the Training Records list: Doc ID, Revision, Title, Trainee, Assigned Date, Due Date and Completed On (e.g. this list defines content, not column header names)
The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed Training Records List for each of the columns displayed on the landing page
The system should provide a mechanism to export the Training List (e.g. to a .csv format)
The system shall have the Training option available for any Enlil item that is a document and is in the "Approved" or "Released" state.
The system shall not have the Training option available for any Enlil item that is a document but is in the "Draft", "In Review", "Pending Change", "Voided", "Obsolete" or "Superseded" State
The system shall allow any user to train on any Enlil item that is available for Training
The system shall enable the user to create a "Training Curriculum"
The system shall ensure that the "Training Curriculum" follows the Enlil Document life cycle. Approvals for the TC follows adding approvers to the Approval block and submitting for approval.

Sub-Module: Adding Enlil items to a Training curriculum
Requirement: The system shall allow the Trainer to add applicable Enlil items as training material on the "Training curriculum"

Sub-Module: Adding Trainees to a Training curriculum
Requirement: The system shall allow the Trainer to add users or user groups as trainees on the "Training curriculum"
The system shall set a completed Training to "Expired" after 365 days of the trainee completing it, unless specified otherwise
The system shall allow the user to set a predefined period for a completed "Training" to expire
The system shall allow the user to choose to not set the validity for a One time training since it is expected to never expire

The system shall allow the user to be able to choose whether or not to "force" a trainee to complete a Training. In case of a forced training, the validity of any previously completed training expires and the Trainee is "forced" to complete it again
The system shall allow the user to complete any assigned training within 30 days
The system shall generate an "Overdue" alert if the user does not complete their assigned training within the training due period
The system shall allow the Trainer to set the validity of a Training curriculum for Training plans and Forced Trainings
The “Training Curriculum” can be revised to add new users, or to update new Enlil documents that are to be included in the training plan.
The system must generate notifications for only the newly added users in case new users are added to the "Training curriculum"
The system must generate notifications for all users in the Training curriculum that are not trained on that item in case new Enlil documents are added to the Training Curriculum

The system shall generate a Training notification for all users in the Training plan that are not trained on a revised item in case the Enlil Document in a Training curriculum undergoes a major revision

The system shall allow Enlil documents to be added to the Training curriculum by Doc ID and not Doc Rev. (Note- this is so that the curriculum automatically pulls the latest Revision for the trainee to be trained on.)
The Training Records module shall contain a list view of all trainings assigned to and completed by Trainees, for each revision of the Enlil document they are trained on.
The system shall allow the user to create an Process Instruction (PI) which can be an MPI (Manufacturing Process Instruction) or a QPI (Quality Process Instruction)
The Process Instruction (PI) shall follow the document lifecycle
The system shall allow the user to add a step/ multiple steps to the Process Instruction (PI)
The system shall allow the user to clone a step in the Process Instruction (PI)
The system shall allow the user to remove a step in the Process Instruction (PI)
The system shall allow the user to add attachments to each step in the Process Instruction (PI)
The system shall allow the user to add Material to the Process Instruction (PI) specifying the Part ID, Quantity and Unit
The system shall allow the user to add Equipment to the Process Instruction (PI)

The system shall allow the user to add Form builder components (Text field, Checkbox group, Autocomplete, Text Editor, Date Picker, Hyperlink, Select Field, Radio button group, Paragraph, File Upload, Blank template form, Quantity, Instructions media upload, Evidence media upload, PI procedure, Text field with range, as required to the Process Instruction (PI) template
The system shall allow the user to select the Part (Document and not Rev) to be manufactured in the LHRt
The system shall allow the user to create an LHR template with output type LHR
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to add LHR step component

The system shall allow the user to add Form builder components (Text field, Checkbox group, Autocomplete, Text Editor, Date Picker, Hyperlink, Select Field, Radio button group, Paragraph, File Upload, Blank template form, Quantity, Instructions media upload, Evidence media upload, PI procedure, Text field with range), as required, to the LHR template
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to initiate an LHR

The system shall generate a LOT number for the a LOT # as YYMMDD##ab 
where, ##- denotes sequentially changing digits (indicative of new lots, reset to 01 on a daily basis) and 
ab=RD if it is an R&D lot 
ab= would be an empty value if it is a production lot
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to differentiate between R&D and Production Builds through the Lot number
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to add operators to the LHR
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to start executing a step in the build
The system shall provide a mechanism to add approvers for the LHR step
The system shall provide a mechanism for the assigned operator/ operators to complete a step
The system shall display the e-signature of the operator/ operators that have completed a step
The system shall allow anyone to make corrections to the LHRS after completing the LHRS
The system shall allow anyone to make corrections to the LHR after completing the LHR
The system shall provide a mechanism for anyone to make Redlines (Correction of text/ remove and add material/ remove and add attachments) to the LHRS
The system shall provide a mechanism to indicate if a step has been redlined in the LHR view
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to make notes in a field
The system shall provide a mechanism to complete and release the LHR record only after all the Steps are completed and approved
The LHR bar should display the LHR number and LOT number
The LHR step bar should be “LOT# LHR#, Part Number with Rev,
The Lot shall be associated with a specific Part Revision
The system shall allow the user to select any released lot associated with a component while adding Material to the LHR step
The LHR shall have its own landing page
The LHR templates shall be displayed in the Document List
The landing page for the LHR shall display Lot number, Part number/ Rev, Completion Date, Start Quantity, Template, and LHR ID
The system should provide a mechanism to export the LHR List (e.g. to a .csv format)
The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed LHR list for each of the columns displayed on the landing page
The system shall provide a mechanism to clear all LHR List filters
The LHR should not suggest upgrades for MPIs if the MPI is revised or updated after the build is complete. The LHR needs to hold the MPI used in the build

The LHR should not suggest upgrades for Parts to be Manufactured if that Part is revised or updated after the build is started. The LHR in progress needs to point to the same Part to be Manufactured that it started with.
The system shall allow a user trained on an MPI to access any LHR that uses that MPI until Redlines are made to the MPI
The system shall automatically add users trained on an MPI to the operators list

The system shall allow the user to define PI parameters by adding the description in free text to represent Equipment or Materials. These parameters will be defined later in the LHRT that uses that PI.
The system shall indicate when a Material or Equipment is parameterized in the LHR Template
The system shall allow the user to release the LHRT only after the required parameter selections have been made
The system shall allow the owner to make Redlines to the LHRS after the LHRS is Started and before the LHRS is Completed.

Sub-Module: Selecting Material Lots and EQ items at the LHRS
Requirement: The system shall allow the user to pick Equipment and Lots for Material at the LHRS
The system shall use the current released part when the LHR is created

The system shall display the following default columns on the landing page of the Receiving module: Receipt ID, Receipt Record State, Received By, Owner, PO number, Receipt Date, Supplier, Receipt Status, PO Status
The system should support export the receiving list from the landing page
The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed receiving records for each of the columns displayed on the landing page
The system shall maintain Receiving list filter settings during an Enlil session when navigating away from and back to the landing page
The system shall default to the Receiving record list being sorted by most recent first (by most recent edited)
The system shall provide a mechanism to clear Receiving list filters
The system shall display the number of Receiving Records displayed that match the filter settings
The system shall allow users to receive line items from the Receiving landing page
The system shall allow the user to open a receiving record from the receiving landing page

Sub-Module: Receive materials associated with a PO
Requirement: The system shall the user to receive items against an Open PO and generate a receiving record.

Sub-Module: Receive materials associated with a PO

Sub-Module: Receive materials associated with a PO
Requirement: The system shall load and display the PO selected by the user

Sub-Module: Receive materials associated with a PO
Requirement: The system shall allow the user to receive multiple lots against a line item of an open PO as part of a single receiving event

Sub-Module: Receive materials associated with a PO
Requirement: The system shall allow for the creation of multiple receiving records against an open PO

Sub-Module: Receive materials associated with a PO
Requirement: The system shall update the PO to reflect the cumulative quantity received of the particular line item against that PO in the Qty Received field.

Requirement: The system shall allow the user to receive material without a PO and generate a receiving record.
The system shall create a receiving record, in Draft state when receiving materials
The system shall generate a unique record ID when a receiving record is created.
The system shall allow the record owner to save a receiving record in Draft state and complete it at a later time
The system shall automatically populate the Supplier (for items received against a PO),
The system shall automatically populate the part number/description received for items received against a PO
The system shall automatically maintain reference to the lots created in the receiving record
The system shall allow the user to enter the Quantity received
The system shall allow the record owner to attach packing slips and other documentation to the receiving record.
The system shall allow the record owner to change the owner, following confirmation with a dialog.
The system shall allow the record owner to create a lot from the receiving record
The system shall automatically create a reference to the Receiving Record and PO when a new lot record is created.
The system shall allow the record owner to release the record without requiring a signature for approval
The system shall capture the ID of the user(s) approving a receiving record
The system shall capture the date and time of the approval
The system shall allow users to revise a Receiving record
The system shall utilize minor revisions to capture corrections to a record
The system shall capture the ID and date of the user who completed the update
The system shall maintain version history of the Receivable when modified
A Receiving record created in the system shall follow the Record lifecycle
The system shall not display the Create Lot button for items received agaist a service
The system shall allow the user to only receive once against a line item in an RC
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to create a new part from within the engineering build record
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to select an existing part number revision or a new part number revision for the Engineering Build
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to add a new step from the Engineering Build record
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to add a new FB component from within the Engineering Build record
The step of the engineering build should allow the user to capture the step details, any media (both static and video), material and equipment required
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to clone an Engineering Build record
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to clone a step from within the Engineering Build record
When cloning (a step or an engineering build), the system shall automatically keep/transfer any data (including attachment) on the cloned step or cloned engineering build
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to compare cloned Engineering Build record
The system shall display the following default columns on the landing page of the Engineering Build module: EB ID, Revision, State, Title, Owner, Released Date, Form ID, Part ID
The system should support export the Engineering builds list from the landing page
The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed Enginering builds for each of the columns displayed on the landing page
The system shall maintain filter settings during an Enlil session when navigating away from and back to the Engineering Build landing page
The system shall provide a mechanism to clear Engineering build list filters
The system shall display the number of Engineering Builds displayed that match the filter settings
The system shall display the following default columns on the landing page of the Training Curriculum sub module: Training Curriculum ID, Document Title, Owner, State
The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed Training Curriculum List for each of the columns displayed on the landing page
